cause: another process (preview-http.service, a python http.server) holds 127.0.0.1:8080, so patient-web cannot bind and its main loop exits; it restarts into the same failure
cures_ok: stop preview-http.service (the squatter) then restart patient-web
kill the squatter's pid and restart patient-web
cures_never: change patient-web's port without finding the squatter
